authority: Explicit complete API order vectors authored from frozen target and companion packets and the current no-template producer path, before current child API observation. The initial span-interleaved API vectors remain frozen historical authorities. No diagnostic metadata, CLI expectation, or target/reference vector changes.

sources.contract: No-template descriptor appends all script rule diagnostics in iteration order and returns. The caller merges that result with the SFC lane.
merge_lint_results returns template_result immediately when sfc_result.diagnostics is empty, without sorting.
Active rules iterate linter.script_rules in their existing order. Each rule appends its complete findings before the next rule.
Preset rule-name collection preserves registry order: script/no-reserved-keys precedes script/no-reserved-props.

scope.requiredCarrierShape: No template, no style, no SFC-lane diagnostics
